blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Content warning: this paper quotes slurs and hateful statements from published test suites; the racial slur among them is masked.
  Automated systems decide at scale which messages are harmful, and they decide unevenly. Classifiers label African American English as offensive up to twice as often as other English, the accounts of prominent drag queens can score as more toxic than those of white nationalists, and safety behaviour that holds in English collapses in low-resource languages. We argue that over-flagging and under-protection share one cause: deciding harm from vocabulary and surface form rather than from what a message does. We organise the evidence into seven failure modes and argue, as testable hypotheses, that harmful behaviours (a request for secrecy, a demand for payment, an attempt to isolate someone) travel across languages better than the words that express them. We propose an evaluation protocol that makes the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities a headline result, and show that the naive gap is inflated under equal service and that its usual bootstrap interval is unreliable. Applied to five open systems in eleven languages, from a keyword lexicon to two current multilingual guard models, the protocol finds that none reaches native-speaker accuracy at separating harmful function from harmless form (51 of 55 system-language pairs fall short); that greater capability raises discrimination in nine languages while leaving Arabic and romanised Hindi near chance, so the gap between the best- and worst-served languages grows with capability; that one system both over-flags and under-protects the same language most; and that a language a system reads worst can look the most fairly treated when only false positives are reported.
blocks.zh:
内容警告:本文引用了已公布的测试套房的流言蜚语和仇恨言论;其中的种族污蔑被掩盖.
自动化系统在规模上决定哪些信息是有害的,它们决定不均匀。 分类者将非裔美国人英语描述为攻击性最高是其他英语的两倍,显著的拖后腿的叙述可以比白人民族主义者更毒,而英语中的安全行为则以低资源语言存在崩溃. 我们争辩说,过度挥霍和保护不足有一个原因:从词汇和表面形式而不是从信息的作用来决定损害。 我们把证据整理成7种失败模式,并且作为可验证的假设,认为有害行为(要求保密、要求付款、试图孤立某人)比表达其语言的词要好。 我们提议一项评价协议,使服务最优和最差语言群体之间的差距成为头条成果,并表明天真的差距在平等服务下被夸大,其通常的靴子间隔是不可靠的。 协议应用到11种语言的5个开放系统,从关键词词典到目前两种多语种的守护模式,发现没有任何一种语言能够准确区分有害功能和无害形式(55种系统语言配对中的51种不足);能力增强在9种语言中引起歧视,同时使阿拉伯语和罗马化的印地语几乎成为可能,因此服务最优和最差语言之间的差距随着能力而扩大;一个系统既超标,又保护最弱的同一种语言;一个系统读得最差的语言在只报告虚假阳性时可以看起来最公平。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Every content-moderation and safety-detection system embodies a theory of what harm looks like. For most of the field’s history, that theory has been lexical: harm is recognised by the presence of certain words, phrases or patterns, learned either from hand-built lists or from datasets in which annotators labelled examples. Modern systems based on large language models are less literal than keyword filters, but they inherit the same orientation when they are trained or evaluated on data that equates harm with how a message looks.
blocks.zh: 每个内容修改和安全检测系统都包含了一个关于什么是伤害的理论. 在大部分领域的历史中,这个理论都是有名词的:某些词语、短语或图案的存在,从手工制作的列表或注释者标出实例的数据集中汲取了教训,从而确认了损害。 基于大语言模型的现代系统比关键词过滤器的字面性要小,但当它们在数据上接受培训或评价,将伤害等同于消息的外观时,它们继承了相同的取向.

blocks.en: This matters because language is not neutral. What counts as aggressive, intimate, joking or threatening is shaped by dialect, community and culture. A word that is a slur in one community is an expression of solidarity in another. A form of teasing that signals closeness among friends reads as hostility to an outsider. And the languages in which a system has seen the most examples of harm are, overwhelmingly, the languages of the people who built it.
blocks.zh: 这很重要,因为语言不是中立的. 所谓攻击性、亲密性、玩笑性或威胁性,是由方言、社区和文化决定的。 一个社区中一个污名的词是另一个社区团结的表示。 一种表示朋友之间亲近的取笑形式 读起来是对外来者的敌意 一个系统所见到的伤害的例子最多的语言, 绝大多数是建造它的人的语言。

blocks.en: The consequence is a double inequity. Speakers of under-represented dialects and languages are more likely to be silenced , because their ordinary speech resembles the system’s idea of harm. They are also more likely to go unprotected , because the harm aimed at them arrives in forms the system has never been shown. This paper brings together the evidence for both, explains why they share a cause, and proposes how the field can measure and reduce them.
blocks.zh: 其结果是双重不平等。 使用代表不足的方言和语言的人更有可能沉默,因为他们的普通话类似于系统的伤害思想。 他们更有可能得不到保护,因为针对他们的伤害以系统从未显示的形式出现。 本文汇集了两者的证据,解释了它们为何有共同的原因,并提出了实地如何衡量和减少这些原因。

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions:
blocks.zh: 该文件提出了四项意见:

blocks.en: (1) It reads the fairness literature (over-flagging of dialects and identities) and the robustness literature (under-protection in low-resource languages) as evidence of a single cause, and argues that remedies for one must be measured against the other (Section 2). (2) It argues that harmful behaviours are a more stable cross-lingual target than harmful vocabulary , illustrates the distinction with published test cases, and states the limits of that argument (Section 4). (3) It organises the published evidence into a taxonomy of seven failure modes, each a distinct way in which a decision based on surface form diverges from a decision based on function (Section 5). (4) It proposes an evaluation protocol in which the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities is a headline result, adapts known statistical results to specify how that gap should be reported and how large test sets must be (Section 6.1), and demonstrates the protocol on five open systems and public test suites in eleven languages (Section 6.2), with recommendations for builders, platforms, regulators and funders (Section 7).
blocks.zh: (1) 它把公平文献(方言和身份的过度扭曲)和稳健文献(资源不足的语言保护不足)视为单一原因的证据,并争论说,必须对照另一原因衡量其中一种补救办法(第2节)。 (2) 缔约国辩称,有害行为是比有害词汇更稳定的跨文化目标,说明了与公布的测试案例的区别,并说明了这一论点的局限性(第4节)。 (3) 它将公布的证据组织成由7个故障模式组成的分类体系,每个模式都有不同的方式,即基于表面形式的决定与基于功能的决定不同(第5节)。 (4) 它提出了一个评价协议,其中最佳和最差服务语言群体之间的差距是头条结果,调整了已知的统计结果,以具体说明应如何报告这一差距,以及必须有多大的测试套(第6.1节),并展示了关于五个开放系统和公共测试套房的11种语言的协议(第6.2节),同时向建设者、平台、监管者和供资者提出建议(第7节)。

blocks.en: It reads the fairness literature (over-flagging of dialects and identities) and the robustness literature (under-protection in low-resource languages) as evidence of a single cause, and argues that remedies for one must be measured against the other (Section 2).
blocks.zh: 它将公平文献(方言和身份的过度浮出水面)和稳健文献(低资源语言的保护不足)解读为单一原因的证据,并争论说,对一种原因的补救必须比照另一种原因来衡量(第2节)。

blocks.en: It argues that harmful behaviours are a more stable cross-lingual target than harmful vocabulary , illustrates the distinction with published test cases, and states the limits of that argument (Section 4).
blocks.zh: 它争辩说,有害行为是比有害词汇更稳定的交叉语言目标,说明了与公布的测试案例的区别,并说明了这一论点的局限性(第4节)。

blocks.en: It organises the published evidence into a taxonomy of seven failure modes, each a distinct way in which a decision based on surface form diverges from a decision based on function (Section 5).
blocks.zh: 它将公布的证据组织成由7个故障模式组成的分类,每个模式都具有独特的方式,即基于表面形式的决定与基于功能的决定不同(第5节)。

blocks.en: It proposes an evaluation protocol in which the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities is a headline result, adapts known statistical results to specify how that gap should be reported and how large test sets must be (Section 6.1), and demonstrates the protocol on five open systems and public test suites in eleven languages (Section 6.2), with recommendations for builders, platforms, regulators and funders (Section 7).
blocks.zh: 它提出了一个评价协议,其中最佳和最差服务语言群体之间的差距是头条结果,调整了已知的统计结果,以具体说明应如何报告这一差距以及必须有多大的测试集(第6.1节),并展示了关于五个开放系统和公共测试套件的11种语言的协议(第6.2节),同时向建设者、平台、监管者和供资者提出建议(第7节)。

blocks.en: What the paper tests and what it does not. The title makes two claims. The empirical part (Section 6.2) tests only the second, that existing moderation decides harm on form, and finds it holds for five quite different systems, including two current multilingual guard models. The first, that harm is better recognised by behaviour and that a system doing so would serve language communities more evenly, is stated as two hypotheses (H1 and H2, Section 4) with the test sets needed to check them (Section 6); it is not tested here, because those test sets do not yet exist for the harms it concerns.
blocks.zh: 报纸测试的是什么 和它没有。 标题提出两项要求。 经验部分(第6.2节)仅测试第二个,即现有的温和度决定了形式上的伤害,并发现它持有五个截然不同的系统,包括两个目前的多语种警卫模式. 第一,通过行为更好地认识到这种危害,而且这样做的系统将更平均地服务于语言群体,这被说成是两个假设(H1和H2,第4节),以及检查这些假设所需的测试集(第6节);在此没有测试,因为这些测试集对于它所关注的伤害尚不存在。

blocks.en: Relation to prior work. Both error directions have been catalogued before. Kiritchenko, Nejadgholi and Fraser (2021) treat the silencing of under-represented groups under fairness, and false negatives, with a call for systems that do not rely on keywords, under safety. Dixon et al. (2018) and Huang et al. (2020) measured per-group error disparities within a language, across identity terms and inferred author demographics. This paper differs in three respects: it argues that the two error directions share one cause and must be evaluated jointly; it takes the language or dialect community, including low-resource languages, as the unit of disparity, paired with cases contrasted by function; and it treats the resulting gap as a statistic whose small-sample behaviour must be accounted for (Section 6.1), where existing disparity metrics are usually reported as point estimates.
blocks.zh: 与以前工作的关系。 这两个错误方向之前都已经编目过. Kiritchenko,Nejadgholi和Fraser (2021年) 以公平的方式对待代表不足的群体的沉默和虚假的否定,同时呼吁不依赖关键词的系统,在安全的情况下. 狄克逊等 (2018)和黄等. (2020年)测量了某一语言内部,不同身份术语的每个组的错误差异,并推断出作者人口统计. 本文在三个方面有所不同:它争辩说,两个错误方向有一个共同的原因,必须共同评价;它把语言或方言群体,包括低资源语言,作为差异的单位,与与与功能相对应的案例对齐;它把由此产生的差距作为必须说明小样本行为的统计(第6.1节),其中现有的差异度量通常作为点估计报告.

blocks.en: We do not evaluate or name any commercial service or API in this paper. Apart from the five open systems of the worked example in Section 6.2, systems that appear are those studied in the cited third-party work.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们不评估或指定任何商业服务或API。 除了第6.2节中工作实例的五个开放系统外,出现的系统是在所引用的第三方工作中被研究的系统。

blocks.en: 2. Two failures with one cause
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 两次失败,一个原因

blocks.en: Over-flagging. A system that associates harm with surface features will assign high risk to any text that shares those features, whatever it is doing. Dialectal grammar, reclaimed terms, profanity used for emphasis or affection, and culturally specific forms of banter all share surface features with abuse. The system cannot tell resemblance from function, so it penalises resemblance.
blocks.zh: 过度放荡. 将损害与表面特征相联系的系统将给任何分享这些特征的文本带来高风险,无论它在做什么。 糖尿病语法、复古名词、用于强调或感情的亵渎、以及文化上特有的布道形式都带有滥用的表面特征。 该系统无法辨别功能的相似性,因此它惩罚了相似性。

blocks.en: Under-protection. The same system can recognise harm only in the forms it has learned. Harm expressed in a language, dialect or script with little training data, in code-switched text, or through behaviour that uses no marked vocabulary at all (a polite request to keep a conversation secret, a friendly offer of money) passes unseen.
blocks.zh: 保护不足。 同一系统只能以它所学到的形式识别损害。 用语言、方言或脚本表达的伤害,没有多少培训数据,用密码转换的文字,或者通过完全没有使用标记词汇的行为(礼貌地要求保守谈话秘密,友好地提议金钱),不为人知。

blocks.en: These errors are usually measured, reported and fixed separately: the first as a fairness problem, the second as a coverage or robustness problem. We argue they should be treated together, because they have the same root and tend to fall on the same communities. The evidence for the two directions comes largely from different populations (dialect penalties are best documented for English varieties, under-protection for low-resource languages), so the claim that they coincide is an inference from shared cause, supported directly in only a few places (Sections 3.2 and 5, mode 4); the protocol in Section 6 is designed to test it, and Section 6.2 tests it on five open systems in eleven languages, finding one system in which the same language receives both failures. A remedy for one that ignores the other can make matters worse: lowering sensitivity to reduce false positives for one dialect reduces protection for its speakers too, and raising sensitivity to catch more harm in a low-resource language, without the data to tell harm from ordinary speech in that language, silences more of its speakers.
blocks.zh: 这些错误通常被测量,报告和单独固定:第一个是公平问题,第二个是覆盖或强性问题. 我们主张他们应该一起对待,因为他们有同样的根基,往往落在同一个社区上. 这两个方向的证据主要来自不同的人群(对英语品种的分辨处罚最好有文献记载,对低资源语言的保护不足),因此它们相合的说法是共同原因的推论,只在少数地方直接支持(第3.2和5节,模式4);第6节中的协议旨在测试它,而第6.2节则在11个语言的5个开放系统中测试它,找到一个系统,在同一语言中接受两种失败. 一种忽视另一种语言的补救办法会使情况更糟糕:降低敏感度以减少一种方言的假阳性也减少了对说方言的人的保护;提高敏感度以低资源语言捕捉到更多的伤害,而不提供数据来辨别该语言中普通语言的伤害,使更多的说方言的人沉默.

blocks.en: One observation sharpens the point. The best-documented dialect penalty concerns African American English, a variety of English, the single best-resourced language in the field. If a lexical orientation misreads a dialect of the language it knows best, the problem is not only a shortage of data. It is what the data is asked to teach.
blocks.zh: 一种观察使观点更加尖锐. 收录最丰富的方言判罚涉及非裔美国人英语,多种英语,是该领域唯一资源最丰富的语言. 如果一个词汇取向错误地读取了它最懂的语言的方言,问题不仅仅是缺少数据. 这是要求数据教的。

blocks.en: 3. What the evidence shows
blocks.zh: 3个 证据显示

blocks.en: 3.1. Dialect and identity are penalised
blocks.zh: 3.1. 糖尿病和身份受到处罚

blocks.en: Sap et al. (2019) found correlations between surface markers of African American English and toxicity labels in widely used hate-speech datasets, and showed that models trained on those datasets propagate the bias: tweets in African American English, and tweets by self-identified African Americans, were up to two times more likely to be labelled offensive. Telling annotators the likely dialect of a tweet made them significantly less likely to label it offensive, locating part of the problem in annotation rather than in the text.
blocks.zh: Sap等人(2019年)在被广泛使用的仇恨言论数据集中发现了非裔美国人英语的表层标记与毒性标签之间的关联,并显示在这些数据集上接受过培训的模型传播了偏见:非裔美国人英语的推特,以及自我识别的非裔美国人的推特,被贴上攻击标签的可能性高达两倍. 将部分问题放在注解而不是文字中。

blocks.en: Davidson, Bhattacharya and Weber (2019) trained classifiers on five different annotated Twitter datasets and found systematic racial bias in all of them: tweets in African American English were predicted abusive at substantially higher rates than tweets in Standard American English. They warned that such systems would disproportionately harm the groups most often targeted by the abuse they are meant to detect.
blocks.zh: Davidson,Bhattacharya和Weber(2019年)在五个不同的注解的Twitter数据集上培训了分类员,并发现所有这些数据集中都存在系统性的种族偏见:非裔美国人英语的推特被预测滥用率会大大高于标准美国人英语的推特. 他们警告说,这种制度会不成比例地伤害他们要发现的虐待最经常针对的群体。

blocks.en: The bias also reflects who does the labelling. Sap et al. (2022) showed that annotators’ identities and beliefs shape toxicity judgements: annotators scoring higher on a scale of racist beliefs were less likely to rate anti-Black language as toxic, and more likely to rate African American English as toxic.
blocks.zh: 偏见也反映了谁做标签。 Sap等人(2022年)表明,注释者的身份和信仰决定了毒性判断:在种族主义信仰规模上评分较高的注释者不太可能将反黑人语言评为有毒,更有可能将非裔美国人英语评为有毒。

blocks.en: The pattern extends beyond race. Dias Oliva, Antonialli and Gomes (2021) measured a widely used toxicity-scoring service on tweets by prominent drag queens in the United States and found that a significant number of their accounts scored as more toxic than those of white nationalists. Drawing on queer linguistics, they identify “mock impoliteness” as a pro-social practice for coping with hostility that a context-blind measure reads as hostility itself. Dixon et al. (2018) had earlier shown that identity terms themselves can become false signals of toxicity when they appear disproportionately in abusive training examples, and proposed measuring such unintended bias with synthetic test sets.
blocks.zh: 模式超越了种族. Dias Oliva, Antonialli和Gomes(2021)在美国著名拖后腿者的推特上测量了广泛使用的毒性分数服务,发现他们的大量账号都比白人民族主义者的账号更有毒性. 根据同性恋语言学,他们将“无礼行为”视为一种有利于社会的做法,用以对付一种视而不见的措施视为敌对本身的敌意。 Dixon等人(2018年)早些时候曾表明,身份术语本身在滥用培训的例子中出现过多时,就可能成为毒性的假信号,并提议用合成测试套衡量这种意外偏差。

blocks.en: 3.2. Most languages are barely served
blocks.zh: 3.2. 多数语言几乎得不到服务

blocks.en: Joshi et al. (2020) documented the disparity in resources across the world’s more than 7,000 languages and questioned the “language-agnostic” status claimed for current models. Nicholas and Bhatia (2023) examined how multilingual large language models are used for content analysis and moderation and found them trained on far more English than other languages, with many languages of the Global South poorly resourced; the systems work substantially better in English.
blocks.zh: Joshi等人(2020年)记录了全世界7 000多种语言的资源差距,并质疑目前模型所称的 " 语言不可知性 " 状况。 Nicholas和Bhatia(2023年)研究了多语种大语言模式如何用于内容分析和节制,发现这些语言比其他语言的英语培训要多得多,全球南方的许多语言资源匮乏;这些系统在英语方面运作得更好。

blocks.en: Where native-speaker resources have been built, they show how much depends on them. Multilingual HateCheck (Röttger et al., 2022) extended functional tests of hate-speech detection to ten languages, with native-speaking experts writing contrastive hateful and non-hateful cases. AfriHate (Muhammad et al., 2025) gathered hate-speech and abuse datasets in fifteen African languages, annotated by native speakers familiar with the regional culture, and found model performance highly dependent on the language. The AfriHate authors also note documented cases in the Global South of both absent moderation and censorship arising from keyword spotting out of context: the two failures of Section 2, observed together. Both projects stress that collection and annotation by local communities is a condition of meaningful measurement, not an enhancement.
blocks.zh: 当地语言资源已经建立起来,它们显示出对资源的依赖程度。 多语言仇恨检查(Röttger等,2022年)将仇恨言论检测功能测试扩展到了10种语言,当地语言专家写出反常的仇恨和非仇恨案例. 非洲荷兰语(Muhammad等人,2025年)收集了15种非洲语言的仇恨言论和虐待数据集,这些数据集由熟悉区域文化的当地人作注释,发现模型性能高度依赖语言。 非洲荷兰语作者还指出,全球南部的一些案例表明,由于关键词被断章取义,既缺乏节制,也缺乏审查:第2节的两个失败都一并观察到。 这两个项目都强调,地方社区的收集和注释是有意义的衡量条件,而不是改进条件。

blocks.en: Between languages lies a further gap. Speakers in multilingual societies routinely code-switch and write one language in another’s script, and this speech falls between the resources for each language. Work on Hindi-English code-mixed hate speech (Bohra et al., 2018) was, by its authors’ account, the first dataset of its kind, and such resources remain scarce; most safety evaluations do not represent mixed-language text at all.
blocks.zh: 语言之间还存在着进一步的差距。 多语种社会中的演讲者通常会用代码切换并用另一种语言的文字写出一种语言,而这种演讲则属于每种语言的资源之间。 关于印地语-英语编码混合仇恨言论(Bohra等,2018年)的作品,据作者称,是首个此类数据集,而此类资源仍然稀缺;大多数安全评价根本不代表混合语言文本.

blocks.en: 3.3. Safety behaviour does not transfer across languages
blocks.zh: 3.3. 安全行为不跨语言转移

blocks.en: The same gap appears in the safety behaviour of large language models. These studies concern what a model will generate rather than what a moderator will flag, but both depend on the model recognising harm in the language of the input, and LLMs are increasingly deployed as moderators themselves. Yong, Menghini and Bach (2023) showed that translating unsafe English prompts into low-resource languages raised the rate at which a widely deployed model’s safeguards were bypassed from under 1% to 79%, while high- and mid-resource languages saw much lower rates. Deng et al. (2024) found that low-resource languages were about three times as likely to elicit harmful content as high-resource ones, even without adversarial intent: a user asking in their own language can receive less protection than a user asking in English.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型的安全行为也出现了同样的差距. 这些研究涉及一个模型会产生什么,而不是一个主持人会标出什么,但两者都依赖于模型识别输入语言的伤害,而LLMs也越来越多地被派作主持人本身. Yong, Menghini和Bach (2023年) 显示,将不安全的英语提示翻译成低资源语言,使广泛部署的模型的保障被绕过的比率从不到1%提高到了79%,而高资源语言和中资源语言的比例则低得多. 邓等 (2024年)发现,低资源语言与高资源语言相比,引出有害内容的可能性大约是高资源语言的三倍,即使没有对抗意图:用自己语言询问的用户可以得到的保护比用英语询问的用户少.

blocks.en: Newer LLM-based moderation tools have widened language coverage without settling the question. Guard models now report coverage of 17 languages (PolyGuard; Kumar et al., 2025) and of 119 (Qwen3Guard; Zhao et al., 2025), with multilingual data leaning substantially on machine translation of English safety data. Independent evaluations are less reassuring: existing guardrails remain ineffective on multilingual toxicity (Yang et al., 2024), code-switched queries elicit unsafe behaviour more often than English ones (Yoo, Yang and Lee, 2024), and SEAHateCheck (Ng et al., 2026) found the lowest accuracy in Tagalog and persistent weaknesses on implicit hate. Multilingual benchmarks point the same way: models generate more toxic text as language resources decrease (PolygloToxicityPrompts; Jain et al., 2024); used as evaluators across 28 languages, they have difficulty discerning context-dependent harm, particularly subtle content such as microaggressions and bias (RTP-LX; de Wynter et al., 2025); and red-teaming prompts collected in several languages separate harms shared globally from harms specific to a local context (Aakanksha et al., 2024). Section 6.2 measures two such guard models directly.
blocks.zh: 较新的基于LLM的节制工具扩大了语言覆盖面,但没有解决问题。 警卫模型现报告覆盖了17种语言(PolyGuard;Kumar等,2025年)和119种语言(Qune3Guard;Zhao等,2025年),多语种数据主要依靠英语安全数据的机器翻译。 独立评估不太令人放心:现有的护栏在多语种毒性方面依然无效(Yang等人,2024年),密码开关的询问往往引起不安全行为,而英语的则比较频繁(Yoo, Yang and Lee,2024年),SEAHateCheck(Ng等人,2026年)发现塔加洛格的准确度最低,暗含仇恨的弱点持续存在。 多语种基准也指出了同样的方式:随着语言资源的减少,模型产生更多的有毒文字(PolygloToxicityPrompts;Jain等人,2024年);作为28种语言的评估者,它们难以辨别依赖环境的伤害,特别是微侵犯和偏见等微妙内容(RTP-LX;de Wynter等人,2025年);以及用几种语言收集的红色导火线将全球共有的伤害与局部环境特有的伤害区分开来(Aakanksha等人,2024年)。 第6.2节直接衡量两种这种警卫模式。

blocks.en: 3.4. The consequences are not hypothetical
blocks.zh: 3.4. 后果不是假设的

blocks.en: An independent human-rights impact assessment commissioned by Facebook concluded that, before 2018, the company had not done enough to prevent its platform from being used to foment division and incite violence in Myanmar, where “Facebook is the internet” (BSR, 2018). Amnesty International (2023) reported that during the conflict in northern Ethiopia, Meta’s content-moderation systems failed to detect and respond appropriately to content targeting the Tigrayan community, while its algorithms amplified it. In both cases the communities most exposed were those whose languages the systems served least.
blocks.zh: Facebook委托进行的一项独立人权影响评估得出结论,2018年之前,该公司没有做出足够努力来防止其平台被利用来煽动分裂和煽动暴力,缅甸的"脸书是互联网"(BSR, 2018). 国际特赦组织(2023年)报道说,在埃塞俄比亚北部的冲突期间,Meta的内容调制系统未能对针对提格雷扬社区的内容进行检测并作出适当的反应,而其算法则放大了. 在这两种情况下,接触最多的社区是系统服务最少的语文社区。

blocks.en: Blodgett et al. (2020) caution that work on “bias” in language technology is often vague about what harm it addresses and to whom. The evidence above is specific: it concerns who is wrongly silenced and who is left unprotected, and in both directions the burden falls on speakers outside a narrow linguistic centre.
blocks.zh: Blodgett等人(2020年)告诫说,关于语言技术的“偏见”的工作往往模糊了它针对的是什么和针对谁。 以上证据是具体的:它涉及谁被错误地沉默,谁得不到保护,在两个方面,负担落在一个狭窄的语言中心以外的发言者身上。

blocks.en: 4. Why behaviour travels better than vocabulary
blocks.zh: 4.四. 为什么行为比词汇要好

blocks.en: The most consequential harms in online safety are acts: deceiving someone into sending money, persuading a child to keep a relationship secret, cutting a person off from their support, threatening them into compliance. Social scientists have long described such harms by what the offender does across an interaction rather than by any particular phrase. O’Connell (2003) described online grooming as a staged process (friendship forming, relationship forming, risk assessment, exclusivity, and only then a sexual stage), and Craven, Brown and Gilchrist (2006) reviewed grooming as a process of preparing a child, the adults around them and the environment for abuse. Lorenzo-Dus, Izura and Pérez-Tattam (2016), analysing 24 published chat logs between convicted groomers and adult decoys, derived an empirical model of grooming discourse whose central “entrapment” phase consists of deceptive trust development (exchanging personal information, discussing relationships and activities, praise, small talk), isolation (physical and mental, with secrecy as part of it), compliance testing and sexual desensitisation, operating as a network of overlapping strategies rather than a sequence. Most of those strategies contain nothing a keyword list would catch: praise, small talk and questions about a child’s day are not harmful words.
blocks.zh: 网络安全中最严重的伤害是行为:欺骗某人送钱,说服孩子保守关系秘密,切断一个人的支持,威胁他们服从. 社会科学家早就用罪犯在互动中的行为来描述这种伤害,而不是用任何特定的短语来描述。 O-Connell (2003年)将在线培养描述为一个分阶段的过程(友情的形成、关系的形成、风险评估、排他性,只有性阶段),Craven、Brown和Gilchrist (2006年)将培养作为培养儿童、周围的成年人以及虐待环境的过程。 Lorenzo-Dus、Izura和Pérez-Tattam(2016年)分析了24个已公布的被定罪的新郎和成人诱饵之间的聊天记录,并产生了一种培养对话的经验模式,其核心的“补救”阶段包括:欺骗性信任发展(交流个人信息、讨论关系和活动、赞美、小说)、隔离(身体和精神,其中一部分是保密的)、合规测试和性淡化,作为一个重叠战略网络而不是一个序列。 这些策略大多没有关键词列表,

blocks.en: These functions exist in every language. The words that perform them do not. A lexicon of manipulative phrases built in one language transfers poorly to another and not at all to a dialect it has never seen, and it is precisely the marked vocabulary of a dialect that a lexical system mistakes for harm. A system asked instead to recognise what a message is doing (requesting secrecy, extracting payment, isolating, threatening) and to read it in the context of the conversation has a target that is, in principle, the same in every language.
blocks.zh: 这些功能存在于每种语言中. 执行这些命令的词没有。 一种语言所构建的操纵性短语词典向另一种语言转移不良,而根本不向它从未见过的方言转移,正是因为一种方言的标志性词汇,一个词典系统误以为是伤害. 一个系统要求承认信息在做什么(要求保密、提取付款、隔离、威胁),并在对话中阅读信息,其目标原则上是每种语言相同的。

blocks.en: Two kinds of contrastive pair make the distinction concrete. The first kind is already in the published record. HateCheck (Röttger et al., 2021) contains hateful and non-hateful test cases that share a slur or a profanity and differ only in what it is doing; Table 1 reproduces three such pairs from the public test suite, with their case identifiers.
blocks.zh: 两种相形相形的对称使区别具体化. 第一种已经载入已公布的记录. HateCheck(Röttger等人,2021年)包含有同一种污秽或放肆的不痛恨的测试案例,并且只在它的行为上有所区别; 表1从公共测试套房复制了三对这样的一对,并附有其案例识别符.

blocks.en: Table 1. Contrastive pairs from the HateCheck test suite (Röttger et al., 2021; case identifiers from the released data). Gold labels are the suite’s own. A slur is masked in this table; the unmasked cases are in the public suite.
blocks.zh: 页:1 1. HateCheck测试套件中的对照对(Röttger等人,2021年;发布数据中的案例识别符)。 黄金标签是套房的自有标签。 本表中用口水遮住;无口水的病例在公共套房.

blocks.en: Röttger et al. report that all four models they tested, two fine-tuned transformers and two commercial moderation services, classified most of the non-hateful reclaimed-slur cases as hateful, with accuracies between roughly 18% and 40% and the commercial services lowest. The same models handled non-hateful profanity almost perfectly. The contrast is instructive: a profanity used for emphasis has been seen often enough in benign data to be learned, whereas a slur used in solidarity has not, so the word rather than its function drives the score. That is failure mode 2 of Section 5, measured, and it shows that the problem is not profanity in general but exactly the in-group uses that belong to particular communities.
blocks.zh: Röttger等 (英语). 报告他们测试过的所有4个型号,2个微调变压器和2个商业温和服务,将大多数不讨厌的回收渣被归类为可恨的,其速率在18%到40%之间,商业服务最低. 同样的模型几乎完美地处理了非憎恶的亵渎行为. 与此形成对比的是具有启发性:在良性的数据中,人们经常看到用于强调的污名,以便学习,而在团结中使用的污名则没有,因此这个词与其功能,不如说它的作用驱动得分。 这是第5节的失败模式2,它表明问题不是一般的亵渎,而恰恰是属于特定社区的团体内部用途。

blocks.en: The second kind of pair is not yet in any public test suite, and that absence is the point. Consider a message of the form “don’t tell your mum about our chats”, sent once by an unknown adult to a 13-year-old and once by that child’s older sibling about a surprise present. The first instance performs what Lorenzo-Dus et al. (2016) call mental isolation, the secrecy strategy inside grooming entrapment; the second performs nothing of the kind. The two share every word, and a lexical system scores them alike. Only the sender, the recipient and the conversation distinguish them, and none of those is a word in the message. This pair is constructed; we know of no public dataset that contains such pairs for grooming, coercion or scams in any language, which is why the protocol in Section 6 asks for them.
blocks.zh: 第二种配对还没有进入任何公共测试套间,而这种缺位就是重点. 请考虑一下“不要告诉你妈妈我们聊天的事”, 第一审执行Lorenzo-Dus等人(2016年)所称的精神隔离,即诱导诱导内幕的秘密策略;第二审则不进行任何此类行为。 两个词都分享,一个词典体系给它们评分相同. 只有发送者,接收者和谈话者能区分他们,这些都不是消息中的一个词. 这对是搭建的;我们知道没有任何公共数据集包含这种搭配,用于以任何语言来诱导、胁迫或骗局,这就是第6节中的协议要求它们的原因。

blocks.en: The argument makes two predictions that can be checked, and we state them so that they can fail.
blocks.zh: 这个论点提出了两个可以检查的预测,我们加以说明,以便它们能够失败。

blocks.en: • H1 (discrimination). On test cases contrasted by function, a system that recognises harm by what a message does will rank harmful cases above their harmless look-alikes well in every language it serves, whatever threshold it is later run at; a system that decides on form will not. Because it is measured before any threshold is set (for example as the area under the ROC curve on contrast cases), this is the direct test of function against form. We set the standard by people rather than by a number: a system meets H1 in a language if its ranking is not reliably worse than the balanced accuracy of an individual native-speaker annotator on the same cases (for a binary decision, ranking quality and balanced accuracy coincide). It falls short if the 95% interval for the difference, from a bootstrap that resamples whole templates, lies entirely above zero. A bar anchored to annotators avoids an arbitrary cut-off, adjusts to how hard the cases are in each language, and asks of a machine only what a native speaker can do. The comparison also favours the systems: AUC credits a system with its whole ranking, while an annotator is scored on a single yes-or-no decision. In the worked example, AUC is at least the balanced accuracy at the system’s own operating point in 42 of the 44 scored combinations (the two exceptions are the toxicity classifier near chance, by at most 0.014), so a system that falls short of the annotators here would almost always fall further short at the threshold it is actually run at. Falling short of H1 is therefore a conservative finding. • H2 (stability). Among systems that discriminate well, one that recognises function will show smaller differences in discrimination across languages than one that recognises form, because the functions recur across languages and the vocabulary does not.
blocks.zh: • H1(歧视)。 在与功能相对应的试验案例中,一个承认信息造成的伤害的系统,将以它所服务的每一种语言,无论它后来的阈值如何,将有害的病例排在无害的外观之上;一个决定形态的系统不会。 由于它是在设定出任何阈值之前被测量的(例如作为对比度下ROC曲线下的区域),这是对函数与形态的直接测试. 我们用人而不是数字来设定标准:如果一个系统的排名不可靠地比单个本地语的注释者在同一案件中的平衡准确性差(对于二进制决定,排名质量和平衡准确性恰好一致),它就会用一种语言满足H1. 如果差异的95%的间隔, 从重新标出整个模板的靴子, 完全在零以上的话, 它就很短 。 与注解者为依托的酒吧可以避免任意的截断,适应每种语言中的情况有多难,只要求一台机器来做讲母语者所能做的事情. 比较也有利于这些系统:AUC以整个排名来评分一个系统,而一个注释员则在单一的"是"或"否"决定上得分. 在例子中,AUC在44个得分组合中的42个至少是系统自身操作点的平衡精度(两个例外是毒性分类器,几乎是0.014),因此,在此处没有注释器的系统在实际运行的阈值上几乎总是会更落后。 因此,低于H1是一个保守的结论。 • H2(稳定性)。 在歧视程度高的制度中,承认职能的系统将显示不同语言的歧视差别小于承认形式,因为不同语言和词汇之间的职能没有重复。

blocks.zh: H2(稳定性). 在歧视程度高的系统中,承认职能的系统将显示不同语言之间的歧视差异小于承认形式,因为不同语言之间的职能和词汇之间没有重复。

blocks.en: Alongside these hypotheses we use a diagnostic. When one per-language setting governs a system’s behaviour (how much of a language a lexicon covers, or where a language’s scores sit relative to a fixed threshold), its false-positive rate on harmless contrast cases and its miss rate on harm without marked vocabulary will be negatively related across languages: the setting decides whether a language is silenced or left unprotected. A strong negative relationship, which we call coupling , therefore shows that coverage or calibration, not what messages do, decides how a system’s errors fall across languages. Its absence is not evidence of the reverse. A system can discriminate poorly and still spread its errors evenly, so coupling describes how failure is distributed and only H1 tests whether function is read.
blocks.zh: 除了这些假设 我们用诊断。 当一个每个语言的设定支配着一个系统的行为(一个词汇覆盖了多少语言,或者一个语言的分数相对于一个固定的阈值)时,它对于无害对比的假阳性率和它对于没有标记词汇的伤害的误差率将会在各种语言之间产生消极的联系:这种设定决定一种语言是沉默还是没有保护。 我们称之为接合的强烈的负面关系表明,覆盖或校正,而不是信息的作用,决定着系统的错误如何跨语言。 它的缺乏并不是相反的证据。 一个系统可以进行差分分辨,仍然平分出出出错,因此相接说明失败如何分布,只有H1测试函数是否被读取.

blocks.en: Section 6.2 measures discrimination for five existing systems and applies the coupling diagnostic to them. It can show only that those systems fall short of H1’s standard. Whether a function-based system meets it, and H2, can be tested only with test sets of the kind Section 6 proposes, which do not yet exist for grooming, coercion or scams.
blocks.zh: 第6.2节对5个现有系统的歧视进行了衡量,并对它们进行了结合诊断。 它只能显示这些系统没有达到H1的标准. 一个基于函数的系统是否与之相会,而H2只能用第6节所提议的测试集进行测试,这些测试组尚不存在来进行调制,胁迫或骗取.

blocks.en: We state the limits of this argument plainly. Recognising behaviour still requires understanding the language it is expressed in, so a behavioural framing does not remove the need for resources in under-served languages; it changes what those resources need to teach. Its empirical base is also narrow: the discourse models cited above are derived largely from chat logs between offenders and adult decoys, which may not reflect conversations with children, and they are almost entirely English. It does not, by itself, remove annotator bias, since someone must still decide what a behaviour is, and the judgement of “who is speaking and about what” in the secrecy pair above is itself culturally shaped. It raises its own risks: a system that reads behaviour across a conversation needs more context than one that scores a message, and more context means more exposure of ordinary private speech to analysis. And it has to be measured as rigorously as any other approach: a system that claims to read behaviour should be held to the same per-language evaluation proposed below. The claim is narrower than “behavioural systems are fair”. It is that defining harm by function gives the field a target that does not privilege any one community’s way of speaking, and that evaluation should reward systems for hitting it.
blocks.zh: 我们明确指出这一论点的限度。 承认行为仍需要理解其表达的语言,因此行为框架并不能消除对服务不足语言资源的需求;它改变了这些资源的教学需求。 其经验基础也很狭窄:上面所引用的论述模式主要出自罪犯和成人诱饵之间的聊天日志,这些记录可能不反映与儿童的对话,而且几乎都是英语. 它本身并不消除注释者偏见,因为必须仍然由人来决定什么是行为,上面的保密条款中“谁在谈论什么”的判断本身是文化上的。 它带来了自己的风险:一个通过谈话来理解行为的制度需要更多的上下文而不是一个给信息打分的上下文,而更多的上下文意味着普通的私人言论更多地接触到分析. 它必须像任何其他方法一样严格地加以衡量:一个声称读取行为的系统应该坚持到下面提议的每语评价. 索赔的范围比“行为系统公平”要窄。 正是这种按功能来界定损害的做法给实地一个不优于任何社区说话方式的目标,而评价应该奖励打它的制度。

blocks.en: 5. A taxonomy of failure modes
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 失败模式的分类

blocks.en: Read through that lens, the evidence of Section 3 falls into seven failure modes. Each is a distinct way in which a decision based on surface form diverges from a decision based on what a message does.
blocks.zh: 从这个镜头来看,第3节的证据分为7个失败模式. 每一种方式都是一种独特的方式,即基于表面形式的决定与基于信息所作决定不同。

blocks.en: Table 2. Seven failure modes of lexical harm detection, the error direction each mainly produces, and the evidence for it.
blocks.zh: 表2. 7个失败模式的词典伤害检测,每个错误方向主要产生,以及它的证据.

blocks.en: Mode 4 cuts both ways: an annotator pool that over-reads a dialect as toxic also under-reads abuse aimed at that dialect’s speakers (Sap et al., 2022). The modes co-occur: a speaker of an under-served variety meets the penalty of modes 1 to 3 and the blindness of modes 5 to 7 at once.
blocks.zh: 模式4削减了两种方式:一个多读出一种方言有毒的注解池,也有低读的滥用该方言者(Sap等人,2022年)。 模式共同使用:服务不足的品种的扬声器同时会受模式1至3的处罚和模式5至7的失明.

blocks.en: 6. An evaluation protocol: make the gap the headline
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 评估协议: 使空白成为标题

blocks.en: Most published safety evaluations report a single score per system, sometimes with a per-language table for the largest languages. We propose that the gap between language communities be reported as a first-class result, measured as follows.
blocks.zh: 大多数已公布的安全评价都报告每个系统有一个单分,有时会有一个针对最大语言的每语表. 我们建议把各语言群体之间的差距作为头等结果报告,具体衡量如下。

blocks.en: (1) Native-authored, parallel test sets. For each language or dialect, cases are written or validated by native speakers from the community, not produced by machine translation alone. Translation tests a system’s handling of translated text, which is not how people speak. (2) Contrastive pairs by function. Each harmful case has a harmless counterpart sharing as much surface form as possible: the same reclaimed term used in solidarity and in attack, the same request made by a parent and by a stranger. This follows the functional-testing approach of HateCheck (Röttger et al., 2021; 2022) and isolates function from form. (3) Both error directions, per variety. For every language and dialect, report the false-positive rate on harmless cases and the miss rate on harmful ones, each with a confidence interval and the number of cases behind it, together with a threshold-free measure of how well harmful cases are ranked above their harmless counterparts, compared with the accuracy of native-speaker annotators on the same cases. Neither error rate alone is meaningful, and the ranking measure separates a system’s failure to read function from its calibration in that language. (4) The gap as the headline figure. Report the difference between the best- and worst-served varieties for each error direction, at a fixed and stated operating point, together with the gap expected if every variety were served equally (Section 6.1). A system whose average is good and whose gap is large is not a good system for the people at the bottom of that gap. (5) Behaviour without vocabulary as its own stratum. Include harmful cases that contain no marked words, so that a lexical system cannot pass the test on vocabulary alone. (6) Mixed language and script. Include code-switched and transliterated cases for the communities that use them. (7) Annotation provenance. State who labelled the data, their relationship to the community, and how disagreements were resolved, following the call by Blodgett et al. (2020) to centre the affected communities. (8) Held-out and refreshed. Keep the test sets out of training data, and refresh them on a schedule, since the words that carry harm change faster than the functions they perform.

blocks.en: 6.1. Measuring the gap
blocks.zh: 6.1 (英语). 衡量差距

blocks.en: The best-minus-worst difference is an extreme-value statistic, and it behaves like one. Even when every variety is served identically, sampling noise produces a positive gap that grows with the number of varieties compared and shrinks only slowly as cases are added (Figure 1a; Table 3). With a true error rate of 10% in every variety, ten varieties of 100 cases each show an expected gap of 9.2 percentage points; at 400 cases each it is still 4.6. A league table of languages built from such data will always have a bottom, whether or not anyone is under-served.
blocks.zh: 最差的差别是极值统计, 它的行为就像一个。 即使每种品种都得到同样的服务,取样噪音也会产生正差,随着品种数目的比较而增长,随着病例的增加而缩小的速度也缓慢(图1a;表3)。 每一种品种的实际误差率为10%,10个品种每100个案例的误差预计为9.2个百分点;每一种案例的误差为400个案例的误差为4.6个。 从这些数据建立的语言联盟表将永远有一个底部,无论是否有人服务不足.

blocks.en: The obvious remedy, a bootstrap interval around the observed gap, does not work. In our simulations (ten varieties, 400 replicates per condition), a stratified percentile bootstrap never covered a true gap of zero, because a maximum minus a minimum cannot be negative, and covered a true gap of 10 points in only 64–76% of replicates, against a nominal 95%.
blocks.zh: 显而易见的补救方法,即环绕所观察到的差距的靴子间隔,是行不通的。 在我们的模拟(10个品种,每个条件复制400个)中,一个分级百分位的靴子从来没有覆盖过真正的零差距,因为最大负最小值不可能是负数,并且只覆盖了64-76%复制品中10分的实际差距,而名义上只有95%。

blocks.en: Neither observation is new to statistics. Lum, Zhang and Bower (2022) showed, for fairness auditing generally, that many disparity metrics computed from group-wise estimates are themselves biased estimators, most severely when some groups are small, and proposed a bias-corrected (“double-corrected”) estimator of the variance of performance across groups. The failure of the bootstrap for a statistic at the boundary of its range is a classical result (Andrews, 2000), and the inflation of the most extreme of many noisy estimates is the “winner’s curse” familiar from genetic association studies (Ioannidis, 2008). What has been missing is their application to cross-lingual safety evaluation, where per-language test sets are small, the number of languages compared keeps growing, and a ranking of languages is exactly what regulators and buyers will read.
blocks.zh: 这两种观察对统计来说都是新的。 Lum、Zhang和Bower(2022年)表明,为了公平性审计,从集团估计中计算出来的许多差距衡量标准本身是偏颇的衡量标准,在一些群体较小的情况下最为严重,并提议对各群体之间业绩差异进行偏差校正(“双校正”)。 在其范围边界上统计的靴子的失败是一个古典结果(Andrews,2000年),许多吵闹估计中最极端的膨胀是遗传关联研究所熟悉的"胜者诅咒"(Ioannidis,2008年)。 所缺少的是它们在跨语言安全评价中的应用,在每种语言的测试集很少,相比语言的数量不断增长,语言的排名正是监管者和购买者会阅读的.

blocks.en: Test sets should be sized to detect the disparities that matter. At a baseline error rate of 10%, about 200 cases per variety give 80% power to detect a single variety served 10 points worse, roughly independently of whether 5, 10 or 20 varieties are compared; detecting a 5-point shortfall needs about 800 (Figure 1b). These sizes apply to each stratum that is compared, so an evaluation reported per language, per error direction and per behaviour needs them in every cell. An implementation of these quantities accompanies the paper.
blocks.zh: 测试机组应规模化,以发现其中的差别。 按10%的基线误差率计算,每种品种约200个案例使检测单一品种的功率达到80%,差了10分,基本上与5个、10个或20个品种的比较无关;检测出5分不足需要约800个(图1b)。 这些大小适用于每个被比较的地层,因此每个语言,每个错误方向和每个行为都报告一个评价需要它们. 实施这些数量与该文件相伴。

blocks.en: 6.2. A worked example on public data
blocks.zh: 6.2. 公共数据实例

blocks.en: To show what the protocol reports, and to apply the discrimination test (H1) and the coupling diagnostic of Section 4, we applied five open systems to public functional test suites in eleven languages. This demonstrates the measurement; it is not an audit of any deployed product, and no commercial service or API was used: the four learned systems are openly licensed models, run by the authors.
blocks.zh: 为了显示协议报告的内容,并运用歧视测试(H1)和第4节的结合诊断,我们对11种语言的公共功能测试套房应用了5个开放系统。 这表明了衡量方法;它不是对任何部署的产品进行审计,也没有使用商业服务或API:四个学习系统都是由作者管理的公开许可模式。

blocks.en: Data. HateCheck (English; Röttger et al., 2021) and Multilingual HateCheck (Arabic, Dutch, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Mandarin, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish; Röttger et al., 2022), whose cases were written or validated by native-speaking experts. We used two strata defined by the suites’ own functionalities. Harmless contrast cases (882–973 per language) are non-hateful cases that share surface form with hate: mentions of identity groups, counter-speech that quotes or references hate, negated hate, non-hateful profanity and, in English only, reclaimed slurs and homonyms of slurs. Vocabulary-free hate (138–145 per language) is the implicit-derogation functionality: hateful statements without slurs, profanity or explicit insults. We excluded abuse aimed at non-protected targets, which the suites label non-hateful but a safety system might reasonably flag.
blocks.zh: Data. HateCheck(英文;Röttger等,2021年)和多语言HateCheck(阿拉伯文、荷兰文、法文、德文、印地语、意大利文、普通话、波兰文、葡萄牙文和西班牙文;Röttger等,2022年),其案例由讲当地语言的专家撰写或验证。 我们使用两个由套房自身功能定义的层次。 无伤害的对比案例(每种语言882–973起)是无怨无味的,与仇恨有着共同的表面形态:提及身份群体,引用或提及仇恨的反言论,否定仇恨,不憎恶的亵渎,仅用英语来说,是回想出污名和同名的污名. 无词汇的仇恨(每个语言138–145)是隐含的贬损功能:仇恨的言论没有污名,亵渎或明显的侮辱. 我们排除了针对不受保护目标的滥用行为,这些套房贴上不受欢迎的标签,但安全系统可能合理标出这种标签。

blocks.en: Systems. (a) A keyword lexicon: a case is flagged if it contains any “conservative” lemma of HurtLex (Bassignana et al., 2018), a lexicon of offensive words in over fifty languages built semi-automatically by translation from an Italian source, after removing very common words (Zipf frequency of 5.8 or more in wordfreq; Speer, 2023), such as English “people” and Spanish “gente”; matching is on word tokens, and on substrings for Mandarin. (b) A toxicity classifier: an open XLM-RoBERTa-large model whose model card lists fourteen training languages, including eight of the eleven tested but not Dutch, Polish or Portuguese (TextDetox, n.d.); a case is flagged at its default threshold of 0.5, with 0.3 and 0.7 as sensitivity checks. (c) A small LLM guard model: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B (Zhao et al., 2025), released in 2025 with reported coverage of 119 languages, given each case as a user prompt; a case is flagged if the model returns Unsafe (counting Controversial as well flags 78–85% of harmless cases in ten languages and 68% in Hindi). (d) A larger guard model: Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, from the same family, used in the same way. (e) A multilingual moderation model: PolyGuard-Qwen (7B parameters; Kumar et al., 2025), trained for safety moderation in seventeen languages that include all eleven tested here. Each case is given as the user’s request with an empty assistant response, and a case is flagged if the model’s probability that the request is harmful is 0.5 or more; that probability is also its score for ranking. Because the guard models are slower, all three were scored on the same cases: every implicit-hate case and a random sample of at least 418 harmless contrast cases per language (all cases for English and Arabic). The two larger models were run on one GPU at 16-bit precision with greedy decoding. All three are built to judge requests to an LLM under a broad safety policy, not to moderate hate speech, so they are tested here outside their intended task.
blocks.zh: 系统.(a) 关键词词典:如果包含HurtLex的任何“保守”的lemma(Bassignana等,2018年),则标出一个案例;在删除了非常常见的词后,用意大利语源翻译的50多种语言编写的攻击性词典(Zipf频率为5.8或更多;Speer,2023年),如英语“people”和西班牙语“gente”;匹配在文字符号上,并用普通话的下字符标出。 (b) 毒性分类器:一个开口XLM-ROBERTa型大型模型,其型号卡片列出了14种培训语言,包括11种测试但荷兰语、波兰语或葡萄牙语中的8种(TextDetox, n.d.);一个案例被标为默认阈值为0.5,其中0.3和0.7作为敏感性检查。 (c) 一个小型LLM警卫型号:Quen3Guard-Gen-0.6B (Zhao等人,2025年),2025年发布,报道涵盖119种语言,因为每个案例都是用户的提示;如果模型返回不安全,则会标出一个案例(用10种语言标出78-85%的无害案例,用印地语标出68%)。 (d) 较大的警卫型号:Qune3Guard-Gen-8B,来自同一家,使用方式相同。 (e) 多语种温和模式:PolyGuard-Quen(7B参数;Kumar等人,2025年),以17种语言接受安全温和培训,包括在此测试的所有11种语言。 每个案例都作为用户的请求,并附有空助理的回复,如果模型中的请求有害的概率为0.5或以上,则标出案例;这一概率也是其排名的分数. 由于护卫模型较慢,所有三个都在同一个病例上得分:每个暗恨病例和每个语言至少418个无害对比病例的随机抽样(所有病例都是英语和阿拉伯语的). 两个更大的模型运行在一个GPU上,精度为16位,并有贪婪的解码. 三者都是为了根据广泛的安全政策判断对LLM的请求,而不是温和仇恨言论,所以他们在这里被测试在他们预定的任务之外.

blocks.en: Results. No system serves any language well in both directions, and only four of the 55 combinations of system and language avoid falling short of the discrimination test (Tables 4 and 5, Figure 2). The lexicon’s balanced accuracy is 0.43–0.53 and the classifier’s AUC 0.52–0.64, where 0.5 is chance. The three guard models do better and differ more: the small Qwen3Guard reaches 0.54–0.73, the 8B model 0.54–0.84 and PolyGuard 0.54–0.87. Individual native-speaker annotators, labelling the same cases when the suites were built, reach a balanced accuracy of 0.70–0.99. Of the 55 combinations, 51 fall reliably short of that standard, by 6 to 55 points (template-level bootstrap, 2,000 resamples). The result does not rest on English, whose suite kept only cases on which most annotators agreed with the gold label and so sets the highest bar: without English, 46 of the 50 remaining combinations fall short. Three of the four exceptions are French, where all three guard models match or exceed the annotators; there, annotators themselves labelled 55% of the harmless contrast cases hateful, so the French bar is low because the French cases are contested, not because the systems read function. The fourth is PolyGuard in Dutch (0.85 against 0.90 for annotators, an interval for the difference that just reaches zero). Even the best English result, PolyGuard’s 0.87, falls 12 points short of English annotators (0.99). By H1’s standard, all five systems still decide largely on form. The harmless contrast cases are look-alikes of implicit hate (counter-speech, negation, reclaimed terms and the like), not matched minimal pairs of it, so this is a test of function against form across two sets of cases rather than pair by pair. They differ in how far they fall short, and in how the resulting errors are distributed across languages.
blocks.zh: 结果。 没有任何一种系统在两个方向上很好地服务于任何语言,在55种系统和语言组合中,只有4种避免低于歧视测试标准(表4和5,图2)。 词典的平衡精度为0.43–0.53,分类器的AUC为0.52–0.64,其中0.5是偶然的. 3个守备型号的成绩更好,差异更大:小的Qune3守备型号达到0.54–0.73,8B守备型号为0.54–0.84和PolyGuard 0.54–0.87. 个别讲本地语的注解员,在建造套房时标出相同的情况,准确度达到0.70-0.99。 在55个组合中,51个可靠地低于该标准,降6至55分(后级靴子圈,2000个复标). 结果不在于英语,英语套间只保留大多数注解者同意金牌的病例,因此设置了最高的栏:没有英语,剩下的50个组合中有46个不足. 四个例外中有三个是法国人,三个守卫模型都匹配或超过注释者;在那里,注释者自己标出55%无害的对比性案例令人憎恨,所以法国的酒吧之所以低,是因为法国的案件受到质疑,而不是因为系统读取功能. 第四是荷兰语的PolyGuard(注解者为0.85对0.90,相差刚刚达到零的间隔). 甚至最优秀的英语成绩,PolyGuard的0.87,相去12分还差英语注音(0.99). 根据H1的标准,所有五个系统仍然主要决定形式. 无害的对比性案例看起来像是隐含的仇恨(反口相声、否定、重新开口等),并不匹配最小的一对,因此这是对两组案例的功能与形态的检验,而不是一对的。 其差距有多大,以及由此产生的错误如何在各语文之间分布,情况各不相同。

blocks.en: The lexicon over-flags most where its coverage is greatest (52.7% of English harmless contrast cases, 41.5% of Mandarin) and barely protects where coverage is thin (Arabic: 4.3% flagged, 100% of implicit hate missed). Its errors are strongly coupled across languages ( ρ \rho = −0.91; −0.88 without Hindi): its coverage of a language decides whether that language is silenced or left unprotected. The implicit hate it does catch is caught largely through identity terms (“gay” and “black”; 黑人 hēirén , Black people; 残疾人 cánjírén , disabled people), the same words that produce its false positives (failure mode 3). Enlarging the lexicon shifts the balance without improving it: without the frequency filter, English over-flagging rises to 70.2% and misses fall to 45.7%.
blocks.zh: 其覆盖度最高的词典(52.7%的英国无害对比案例,41.5%的普通话)和覆盖度低的几乎无法保护(阿拉伯语:4.3%,100%的隐含仇恨被忽略)。 它的误差在各种语言之间有很强的结合(ρrho = -0.91;-0.88没有印地语):它对一种语言的覆盖决定该语言是沉默还是无保护. 它所捕捉到的隐含仇恨主要通过身份术语(“同性恋”和“黑人”)来捕捉; /黑人 hēirén, Black people;/残疾人 cánjírén, 残疾人),与产生其虚假阳性(失败模式3)的同名词. 将词汇词典转换为平衡而不改进:没有频率过滤器,英语过度浮动升至70.2%并漏入45.7%.

blocks.en: The classifier over-flags far more (39–62% of harmless contrast cases in every language) and misses less (19–54%). Its errors are also coupled ( ρ \rho = −0.73, p = 0.01; −0.88 at a threshold of 0.7; −0.79 with non-hateful profanity removed), and discrimination explains why. Its ranking of implicit hate above harmless contrast cases is close to chance in every language and lowest in English (AUC 0.52), while its typical score on harmless cases ranges from 0.03 in French to 0.83 in Portuguese. At a fixed threshold, each language’s calibration then decides which failure it receives: coupling produced by calibration rather than by coverage, in a learned model rather than a word list.
blocks.zh: 分类器的超标程度要高得多(每种语言中无害对比病例的39-62%),少得多(19-54%)。 其错误也相互交织在一起( ^\rho = -0.73, p = 0.01; − 0.88, 起点为 0.7; − 0.79, 消除了非仇恨的亵渎), 歧视解释了原因。 它将隐性仇恨排在无害对比案例之上,在每种语言中都接近机会,在英语中最低(AUC 0.52),而在无害案例上的典型分数从法语的0.03分到葡萄牙语的0.83分. 在固定的阈值上,每种语言的校正然后决定它得到的失败:通过校正而不是通过覆盖,在一个学习过的模型而不是一个单词列表中产生的耦合.

blocks.en: The small guard model shows no coupling ( ρ \rho = −0.23, p = 0.50). This is not evidence that it reads function. Its discrimination is better than the classifier’s in nine of the eleven languages, but it remains far from reliable separation (AUC 0.54–0.73) and is weakest in romanised Hindi and Arabic, the languages it protects least; its errors are distributed differently, not avoided. It over-flags at a high and nearly uniform rate (40–50% of harmless contrast cases in ten languages; counter-speech is flagged 64–66% of the time and reclaimed slurs 52%), while its protection falls away from English: it misses 15% of English implicit hate, 19–50% elsewhere and 72% in romanised Hindi, and its discrimination is highest in English (AUC 0.73) and lowest in romanised Hindi and Arabic (0.54 and 0.55). Its over-flagging is shared by every language; its disparity lies in protection.
blocks.zh: 小后卫模式显示没有接合(^rho=-0.23,p=0.50). 这不是它读取功能的证据。 其歧视比十一种语言中的九种语言的分类者要好,但远未实现可靠的分离(AUC 0.54–0.73),而且最弱的是罗马化的印地语和阿拉伯语,这是它保护最少的语言;其错误分布不同,没有避免。 它的超标率很高,几乎一致(10种语言的无害对比病例占40-50%;反口音标出64-66%的时间并回收了52%的口水),而其保护则远离英语:它忽略了15%的英语隐含仇恨,19-50%在其他地方和72%在罗马化印地语中,其歧视在英语中最高(AUC 0.73),在罗马化印地语和阿拉伯语中最低(0.54和0.55)。 每一种语言都带有过度的色彩;其差异在于保护。

blocks.en: Capability raises the ceiling, not the floor. The two larger guard models read function far better than the small one in nine languages: averaged over those nine, AUC rises from 0.65 for the small Qwen3Guard to 0.81 for both its 8B sibling and PolyGuard. In Arabic and romanised Hindi it barely moves: 0.55 and 0.54 for the small model, 0.59 and 0.54 for the 8B model, and 0.59 and 0.54 for PolyGuard, although both languages are among PolyGuard’s seventeen training languages. The spread of discrimination across languages therefore widens with capability, from 0.20 for the small guard model to 0.29 for the 8B model and 0.33 for PolyGuard. The 8B model misses 9–24% of implicit hate in the nine languages, 63% in Arabic and 77% in romanised Hindi, while its over-flagging (20–31% of harmless contrast cases) varies no more than chance would produce. Judged by its average, the better model is here the more unequal one: the languages already served worst gain least.
blocks.zh: 能力提高天花板,而不是地板。 两个较大的护卫型号读取功能远好于9种语言的小护卫型:平均比这9种要好,AUC从小的Qune3护卫的0.65起上升到了它的8B兄弟姐妹和多护卫的0.81起. 在阿拉伯语和罗马化的印地语中,虽然两种语言都属于PolyGuard的17种培训语言,但小模型的0.55和0.54、8B模型的0.59和0.54以及PolyGuard的0.59和0.54几乎没有移动。 因此,不同语言之间歧视的传播随能力而扩大,从小看守模式的0.20到8B模式的0.29和多看守模式的0.33。 8B模式忽略了9—24 % 的九种语言暗含仇恨,63%为阿拉伯语,77%为罗马化印地语,而其过度飘忽不定(20—31 % 无害的对比案例)则无异于产生机会。 从平均来看,最好的模式是不平等的:已经使用最糟糕的语言所得最少。

blocks.en: One language, both failures. PolyGuard over-flags heavily everywhere (57–69% of harmless contrast cases) and, outside Arabic and romanised Hindi, misses almost no implicit hate (0.7–5.7%). Its errors are related positively across languages rather than negatively ( ρ \rho = 0.65 without Hindi, p = 0.04; 0.24 with it, p = 0.48): the language it reads worst is the one it silences most and protects least. In Arabic it flags 69.0% of harmless contrast cases (Wilson interval 65.9–72.0), more than in any other language, and misses 15.9% of implicit hate (10.8–22.7), almost three times its rate in any other language but Hindi. This is the double inequity of Section 2 inside a single system. It is also a pattern the coupling diagnostic of Section 4 does not look for, since that diagnostic asks whether one setting trades one failure for the other; here nothing is traded. The Arabic cases are not unreadable: native annotators separate them with a balanced accuracy of 0.86.
blocks.zh: 一种语言 两种失败 PolyGuard公司在任何地方的旗子都非常多(57-69%的无害对比案例),在阿拉伯语和罗马化的印地语之外,几乎没有暗含仇恨(0.7-5.7%)。 其错误在各种语言之间是正面的,而不是负面的(没有印地语的\rho = 0.65;p = 0.04;加上它的0.24;p = 048):它读得最糟糕的语言是它沉默得最多,保护得最少的语言. 在阿拉伯语中,它标出69.0%的无害对比案例(威尔逊区间65.9-72.0),比任何其他语言都要多,并忽略了15.9%的隐性仇恨(10.8-22.7),几乎是除印地语外任何其他语言的三倍。 这是第2节在单一系统内部的双重不平等。 这也是第4款的结合诊断所没有寻找的一种模式,因为这一诊断问,一个设定的失败是否与另一个交易;这里没有任何交易。 阿拉伯病例并非无法读取:本土的注释者将它们分开,平衡准确度为0.86.

blocks.en: The five systems therefore share one failure, deciding largely on form, which is the common cause this paper argues for, and distribute its consequences in four different ways: by lexical coverage (the lexicon), by per-language calibration (the classifier), by uniform over-flagging combined with protection that declines away from English (the Qwen3Guard models), and by concentrating both failures on one language (PolyGuard). A single aggregate score hides the shared failure, the differences, and the fact that a stronger model’s gains can pass by the languages that need them most; a per-language report that gives both error directions and the threshold-free ranking shows each.
blocks.zh: 因此,这五个系统有一个共同的失败,主要决定形式,这是本文所主张的共同原因,并以四种不同的方式分配其后果:通过语法覆盖(词典),通过按语法进行校正(分类),通过统一过度花旗,加上脱离英语的保护(Qune3Guard模型),以及将两种失败集中在一种语言(PolyGuard)上. 一个单一的汇总分数隐藏了共同的失败,差异,以及一个更强大的模型的得分可以通过最需要它们的语言来传递的事实;一个每个语言的报告,既给出了错误的方向,又给出了无门槛的排名分别显示.

blocks.en: Romanised Hindi shows why both directions must be reported together. Multilingual HateCheck writes Hindi in Latin script, as much informal Hindi online is written (cf. the code-mixed data of Bohra et al., 2018), while HurtLex’s Hindi entries are in Devanagari. The lexicon therefore flags nothing (0.0% false positives, the best in its column, alongside 100% missed), and all three guard models flag fewer Hindi harmless cases than in any other language (22.7%, 19.9% and 56.7%) while missing more Hindi implicit hate than in any other language (72.1%, 77.1% and 40.0%). Reported in one direction only, all four would make the language they read worst look the most fairly treated (failure mode 6). The classifier, which handles romanised Hindi (18.6% missed), shows that this is a property of particular systems, not of the language.
blocks.zh: 罗马化的印地语说明为什么必须同时报告这两个方向。 多语种HateCheck用拉丁文写出印地语,因为在线非正式的印地语是被写作的(参见Bohra等2018年的代码混合数据),而HurtLex的印地语条目则在Devanagari. 因此,词典没有标出任何印地语(0.0 % 的假阳性,其一栏中最好,加上100%被忽略),所有三个卫士模型都标出比任何其他语言少的印地语无害病例(22.7%、19.9%和56.7%),同时没有标出比任何其他语言多的印地语隐含仇恨(72.1%、77.1%和40.0%)。 仅从一个方向报告,这四个人将使他们读得最糟糕的语言看起来最公平(失败模式6)。 处理罗马化的印地语(18.6%漏发)的分类器显示,这是特定系统而非语言的属性.

blocks.en: Gap statistics. Applying Section 6.1 with templates as clusters, since cases generated from one template are not independent: for the lexicon, the over-flagging gap is 52.7 points (English against Hindi) against 8.5 expected under equal service, and the gap in missed implicit hate is 45.7 points (Arabic against Mandarin) against 19.7 expected (both p < 0.001). For the classifier, the gaps are 22.6 points against 10.1 expected (p < 0.001) and 35.7 against 23.3 (p = 0.03). For the small guard model, the gap in missed implicit hate is 57.1 points (romanised Hindi against English) against 22.7 expected (p < 0.001), and 34.7 against 21.0 without Hindi (p = 0.01); its over-flagging gap comes entirely from Hindi and is no larger than chance without it (9.9 against 11.6, p = 0.70). For the 8B guard model, the gap in missed implicit hate is 68.6 points (romanised Hindi against English) against 23.5 expected, and 54.9 against 20.1 without Hindi (Arabic against English; both p < 0.001); for PolyGuard it is 39.3 against 12.7 (p < 0.001), and 15.1 against 8.4 without Hindi (p = 0.003). Neither larger model’s over-flagging gap is larger than chance (11.2 against 11.6 and 12.3 against 12.6; p = 0.52 and 0.50). P-values are from 5,000 template-level permutations. The gap expected by chance for implicit hate is about 1.7 times what independent cases would give, because each language has only about 20 implicit-derogation templates: for this comparison, the number of templates, not the number of cases, limits precision.
blocks.zh: 差距统计。 将第6.1节与模板作为集群应用,因为从一个模板生成的案件并不独立:对于词汇,过度浮动的差距是52.7分(英语对印地语),而平等服务下预期的为8.5分;错失的暗含仇恨的差距是45.7分(阿拉伯语对普通话),而预期的为19.7分(都为 < 0.001页)。 就分类法而言,差距为22.6分,预计为10.1分(p < 0.001),35.7分为23.3分(p=0.03)。 对于小后卫模式,错失的隐含仇恨差距为57.1分(罗马化印地语对英语)与预期的22.7分(p < 0.001)相差34.7分,没有印地语(p=0.01)相差21.0分;其过度飘移的差距完全出自印地语,没有印地语并不大于机会(9.9分对11.6分,p=0.70分). 8B的后卫模式中,错失了隐含仇恨的缺口为:68.6分(罗马化的印地语对英语)与预期的23.5分;54.9分与没有印地语的20.1分(阿拉伯语对英语;都为 < 0.001;PolyGuard为39.3分与12.7分(p < 0.001),15.1分与没有印地语的8.4分(p=0.003). 两种较大的模型的过度悬挂相差都大于机会(11.2对11.6和12.3对12.6;p=0.52和0.50)。 P值取自5000个模板级通相. 由于每种语言只有大约20个隐含的贬损模板:对于这一比较来说,模板的数量,而不是案件的数量,限制了精确度,因此隐含仇恨的偶然预期差距是独立案例的1.7倍左右.

blocks.en: Limits of the example. The suites are synthetic and templated, and none of the eleven languages is low-resource in the sense of Section 3.2, so the example likely understates the disparities at issue. The suites are parallel by functionality, not translation, so per-language differences combine system behaviour with how the cases were written. Each system was tested at one version and one operating point; PolyGuard was given each case as a request with no response. HateCheck has been public since 2021 and may overlap with the learned systems’ training data, which would favour them. The AUCs compare two sets of cases with different functions, not matched minimal pairs. The annotator standard comes from the suites’ own validation annotators; the English suite keeps only cases most annotators agreed on, which raises the English bar, and some French contrast cases are contested. What the example establishes is that five quite different systems, including two current multilingual guard models, fall short of native speakers at separating function from form; that greater capability narrows the shortfall unevenly, leaving the worst-served languages furthest behind; and that only a two-direction, per-language report makes this visible.
blocks.zh: 例之所限. 套房是被合成并模板化的,11种语言中没有一个是第3.2节意义上的低资源,因此这个例子可能低估了所争论的差别. 套房的功能平行,不是翻译,所以每个语言的差异都结合了系统行为和案例的写作方式. 每个系统在一个版本和一个操作点进行了测试;作为请求向每个案例提供了PolyGuard,但没有回应. 讨厌 自2021年起,检查开始公开,可能与学习系统的培训数据相重叠,这将有利于它们。 AUCs比较了两组具有不同功能的案件,不匹配最小对. 注释员的标准来自套房本身的验证注释员;而英语套房只保留大多数注释员同意的案件,这提高了英国的酒吧,一些法国的对比性案件受到争议. 例子证实,五个完全不同的系统,包括两个目前的多语种警卫模式,在将功能与形式区分开来时没有当地语言使用者;能力增强会缩小差距,使服务最差的语言落在最后方;只有两个方向,每个语言的报告才能使这一点变得明显。

blocks.en: 7. Recommendations
blocks.zh: 7. 建议

blocks.en: For builders of safety systems.
blocks.zh: 安全系统建设者。

blocks.en: • Define harm by function, and test that definition with contrastive pairs before shipping. • Measure and publish per-variety error rates in both directions, including the gap. • Treat a fix for false positives in one community as unfinished until its effect on that community’s protection is measured, and vice versa.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 以函数定义损害,并在运输前用对比对来测试该定义。 • 衡量和公布两个方向的每个差错率,包括差距。 将一个社区中的假阳性症的治疗视为未完成,直到该社区的保护效果得到衡量,反之亦然。

blocks.en: Define harm by function, and test that definition with contrastive pairs before shipping.
blocks.zh: 以函数定义损害,并在运输前用对比对来测试该定义。

blocks.en: Measure and publish per-variety error rates in both directions, including the gap.
blocks.zh: 测量和公布双向的每千分率出错率,包括差距。

blocks.en: Treat a fix for false positives in one community as unfinished until its effect on that community’s protection is measured, and vice versa.
blocks.zh: 将一个社区中的假阳性症的治疗视为未完成,直到该社区的保护效果得到衡量,反之亦然。

blocks.en: For platforms deploying them.
blocks.zh: 用于部署它们的平台。

blocks.en: • Ask vendors for per-language and per-dialect error rates, not averages. • Route uncertain cases in under-served languages to human reviewers who speak them, rather than to automatic action. • Do not use a system’s silence in a language it barely supports as evidence that nothing harmful happened.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 向销售商询问每语和每分辨误差率,而不是平均值。 • 以服务不足的语言将不确定案件交给讲这些案件的人类审查人员,而不是自动采取行动。 避免用系统沉默的言语,

blocks.en: Ask vendors for per-language and per-dialect error rates, not averages.
blocks.zh: 向销售商询问每语和每分辨误差率,而非平均值.

blocks.en: Route uncertain cases in under-served languages to human reviewers who speak them, rather than to automatic action.
blocks.zh: 以服务不足的语言将不确定案件交给说这些语言的人审查者,而不是自动采取行动。

blocks.en: Do not use a system’s silence in a language it barely supports as evidence that nothing harmful happened.
blocks.zh: 不要用系统沉默的言语,

blocks.en: For regulators and auditors.
blocks.zh: 监管者和审计员。

blocks.en: • Require that risk assessments under online-safety regimes (for example the systemic-risk assessment and mitigation duties of the EU Digital Services Act, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065, Articles 34 and 35 (European Union, 2022), and the illegal-content and children’s risk assessments of the UK Online Safety Act 2023, sections 9 and 11; United Kingdom, 2023) report performance by language for the populations a service actually serves. • Treat the gap between language communities as a measure of whether a service protects all its users.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 要求根据在线安全制度进行风险评估(例如《欧盟数字服务法》的系统风险评估和减轻风险义务、第2022/2065号条例(欧盟)第34和35条(欧盟,2022年),以及联合王国《2023年在线安全法》第9和11条的非法内容和儿童风险评估;联合王国,2023年)按实际服务语言报告人口的绩效。 二. 支助 将语言社区之间的差距作为衡量服务是否保护所有使用者的一个尺度。

blocks.en: Require that risk assessments under online-safety regimes (for example the systemic-risk assessment and mitigation duties of the EU Digital Services Act, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065, Articles 34 and 35 (European Union, 2022), and the illegal-content and children’s risk assessments of the UK Online Safety Act 2023, sections 9 and 11; United Kingdom, 2023) report performance by language for the populations a service actually serves.
blocks.zh: 要求根据在线安全制度进行风险评估(例如《欧盟数字服务法》的系统风险评估和减轻风险义务、第2022/2065号条例(欧盟)第34和35条(欧盟,2022年),以及联合王国《2023年在线安全法》第9和11条的非法内容和儿童风险评估;联合王国,2023年)按实际服务语言报告人口的绩效。

blocks.en: Treat the gap between language communities as a measure of whether a service protects all its users.
blocks.zh: 将语言社区之间的差距作为衡量服务是否保护所有使用者的一个尺度。

blocks.en: For researchers and funders.
blocks.zh: 对于研究人员和资助者。

blocks.en: • Fund native-speaker datasets for safety tasks beyond hate speech, including scams, coercion and grooming, where almost none exist outside a few languages. • Build shared, community-owned evaluation sets that no single vendor controls.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 资助母语数据集,用于仇恨言论以外的安全任务,包括骗局、胁迫和诱导,在少数语言之外几乎没有任何此类数据。 • 建立共同的、由社区自主的、没有单一供应商控制的成套评价。

blocks.en: Fund native-speaker datasets for safety tasks beyond hate speech, including scams, coercion and grooming, where almost none exist outside a few languages.
blocks.zh: 资助母语数据集,用于仇恨言论以外的安全任务,包括骗局、胁迫和诱导,在少数语言之外几乎没有任何此类数据。

blocks.en: Build shared, community-owned evaluation sets that no single vendor controls.
blocks.zh: 建立共享的、社区拥有的评价机制,即没有单一的供应商控制。

blocks.en: 8. Limitations
blocks.zh: 8. 限制

blocks.en: Apart from the worked example in Section 6.2, this paper reports no new measurements: it tests H1 only in one direction, showing that five existing systems fall short of its standard, and does not test H2. Most of the evidence concerns hate speech and English dialects, where the most rigorous work exists; failure modes 6 and 7 outside hate speech are argued from the structure of the problem rather than measured. The results of Section 6.1 assume independent cases, and clustered test sets widen every interval. Some cited studies describe systems as they were when studied. The pairs in Table 1 are written test cases and the secrecy pair in Section 4 is constructed; neither is a measurement.
blocks.zh: 除了第6.2节中的例子外,本文件没有报告新的测量:它只从一个方向测试H1,表明现有5个系统没有达到标准,没有测试H2. 多数证据涉及仇恨言论和英语方言,其中存在最严格的作品;失败模式6和7外部仇恨言论是从问题的结构,而不是衡量出来的. 第6.1节的结果假设独立案例,分组测试集会扩大每个间隔. 一些研究列举了研究时的系统。 表1中的对子是书面测试案例,而第4节中的保密对子是构建的;也不是一种测量。

blocks.en: Statements
blocks.zh: 发言

blocks.en: Code and data availability. The worked example uses only public resources: HateCheck and Multilingual HateCheck test cases, the HurtLex lexicon, the wordfreq frequency lists and four openly licensed models (an OpenRAIL++ toxicity classifier, the Apache-2.0 Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B and Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, and the CC BY 4.0 PolyGuard-Qwen), run by the authors: the first two on a workstation, the larger two on one rented GPU. The reproduction package, with the source code for the gap statistics (Section 6.1), the simulations and the worked example (Section 6.2) and the per-case outputs for every system, is available at https://osf.io/v7aef/files/osfstorage?view_only=9449667241894b1ca7d336fc4b8259d8 .
blocks.zh: 代码和数据提供情况。 工作实例只使用公共资源:HateCheck和多语言HateCheck测试案例,HurtLex词汇表,wordfreq频率列表和4个公开许可的模型(OpenRAIL++毒性分类器,Apache-2.0 Qune3 Guard-Gen-0.6B和Qune3 Guard-Gen-8B,以及CC BY 4.0 PolyGuard-Quen),由作者运行:前两个在工作站,较大的两个在一个租用的GPU上. 复制包,有差距统计的源代码(第6.1节),模拟和实例(第6.2节),以及每个系统的每个案例产出,可查阅https://osf.io/v7aef/files/osfstorage?view_ only=9449667241894b1ca7d336f4b8259d8。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations. The worked example uses only public, synthetic test suites written or validated by their authors’ native-speaking annotators; it involves no human subjects, no user data and no deployed product. The suites contain slurs and hateful statements by design; the racial slur quoted in Table 1 is masked. No system was tuned on the test cases.
blocks.zh: 道德考虑。 该实例只使用由作者的本地语言注释员编写或验证的公开的合成测试套件;它没有涉及人的主体,没有用户数据,也没有部署的产品。 套房里有口水和仇恨的言论;表1所引用的种族口水被遮住. 测试案例没有系统。

blocks.en: Generative AI usage. The ideas, research questions, arguments and conclusions in this paper are the authors’ own, and the authors wrote and revised the text. A generative AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic) provided drafting and language-editing support under the authors’ direction, and wrote and ran the validation, test and analysis code and formatted the final file. The authors reviewed all of it, reproduced every number from the released code, and take full responsibility for the paper.

blocks.en: Conflict of interest
blocks.zh: 利益冲突

blocks.en: Gabriel Lars Sabadin is the founder, chief executive and chief technology officer of Tuteliq AB, a company that develops systems for detecting harmful behaviour in online conversations, including approaches of the behavioural kind discussed in Section 4. Nicola Harding is a co-founder and the chief scientific officer of Tuteliq AB, and Sarah Kingston is a senior advisor to Tuteliq AB. All three therefore have an interest in the field adopting the framing this paper argues for. The paper evaluates no commercial service or API and no Tuteliq product. Its worked example (Section 6.2) applies a keyword lexicon and four openly licensed models, run by the authors, to public test suites, and it makes no claim about the performance of any Tuteliq product. The evaluation protocol in Section 6 is proposed as a standard to which any such product should also be held.
